contract.input: contiguous BF16 NPU tensor, rank-3 [B, S, H]
outputs: output int8 storage same shape as x
contract.int4_storage: logical signed int4 values in [-8, 7] carried by int8 unpacked storage

solution.name: dynamic_quant_triton_ascend
solution.author: OpenAI Codex
solution.description: Triton-Ascend BF16 per-row dynamic int8 and logical int4 quantization.
assumptions: Input tensors are contiguous BF16 tensors with rank 3 as required by the operator contract.
The scored path supports dst_type=int8 and dst_type=int4; logical int4 is returned as unpacked signed values in int8 storage.

tuning_params.program_mapping: one Triton program per B*S row for rows<=48; rows>48 and hidden<=8192 use a 48-program row-stride exact kernel; larger hidden uses a single row program with runtime hidden-bucket inner chunks
tuning_params.hidden_block: single-kernel exact hidden width up to 8192; rows>48 exact path uses tl.range row striding over 48 programs; single-kernel two-pass chunk loop with BLOCK_H=4096 for hidden>8192; divisible loop shapes use a no-tail unmasked variant selected by hidden % BLOCK_H == 0
tuning_params.reduction_dtype: no-tail exact, row-stride, and divisible-loop paths reduce abs/max on BF16 input values, then convert the reduced max to fp32 and use BF16*fp32 promotion for quantization math; full-public eval_20260616_233746 kept this path on the official active_vs_active metric
tuning_params.rounding: Triton-Ascend extra.cann.libdevice.round(q) is used before int8 storage; direct q.to(tl.int8) was rejected because selected timing worsened despite correctness; libdevice.rint(q) was rejected because the selected CANN-Bench run failed with invalid/missing kernel_details.csv
tuning_params.compile_hints: Triton-Ascend 3.2.1 al.multibuffer(x, 2) is applied after no-tail loads in exact, row-stride, and divisible-loop kernels; launch-level multibuffer=False is not used because selected exact-H8192/INT4 guard timing worsened and case12 became an active regression; tl.max_contiguous/tl.multiple_of address hints are not used because selected exact/row-stride timing worsened; enable_auto_vectorize_v2 is not used because CANN 9.0 bishengir-compile rejected the generated --enable-auto-vectorize-v2=True option; disable_size_align_for_cast is not used because selected exact-kernel timing worsened; removing the manual hint from only the simple exact kernel was rejected because selected target cases did not improve

known_risks: Exact half-way rounding may differ by one quantization unit from framework round-to-even semantics.

baseline_provenance.pytorch_fallback_reason: 20 logical INT4 unpacked-storage cases have no stable public torch_npu.npu_dynamic_quant baseline for this contract; case13 INT8 official helper validation mismatched by max_diff=1 during calibration
